messages:
noah: Heads-up team  we're deprecating the legacy JSON examples schema used across SDK docs (old `request_v1` / `response_v1` blocks). New schema (`io.v2.json`) is more expressive and fixes several ambiguity issues with streaming/partial responses. Preview of updated pages is up: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/sdk/json-schema-v2-preview. Deprecation timeline and migration notes below.

priya: What's the migration surface? Will customers' saved examples break? :worried:

noah: Two parts: docs examples and sample payloads in the examples repo. Docs will show both schemas side-by-side for one release with a deprecation warning on the legacy blocks. The examples repo will get automated codemods to update sample fixtures. Existing customer payloads are unaffected unless they copy/paste the example verbatim and rely on the old field names. We'll include a clear mapping table.

priya: Any SDK API changes required? Or just docs/schema rename?

noah: Mostly docs/schema. SDKs accept both v1 and v2 shapes for now with a compatibility shim. We'll emit a runtime warning when v1 is used in interactive/TTY environments and log a single telemetry event when running in Hosted. The shim will be removed after 4 weeks from full rollout. So for SDK consumers: no immediate code changes required, but please update internal examples and e2e fixtures.

priya: Can we get a codemod for Python and JS? Will it be idempotent?

noah: Yes. We'll publish two codemods (js, py) that 1) rename fields, 2) convert streaming placeholders to the new partial-chunk format, and 3) update import paths for test fixtures. Codemods are intended to be idempotent; we'll include a dry-run mode and output a summary of changed files. Links will be in the preview doc.

docs-bot: docs deploy scheduled: sdk/json-schema-v2 -> preview cluster 2026-04-10T15:00:00Z (canary).

eng-release: Release note for release train: minor version bump for SDK packages containing the shim. Deprecation shim removal scheduled for vX.Y+1 (approx 4 weeks post-rollout). Please ensure release notes include the shim warning and codemod links.

security-bot: Security check: migrating schema does not change server-side validation. Important: do not include real user prompts or PII in example payloads. We'll run a quick scrub on the examples repo to redact obvious secrets before codemod PRs are opened.

priya: Any telemetry/opt-out notes for Dedicated/Private customers?

noah: Good call. Telemetry for migration (counts of v1->v2 conversions) is off by default for Dedicated/Private and opt-in for Hosted. We'll document the exact telemetry events and provide an env var `REDWOOD_DOCS_MIGRATION_TELEMETRY=1|0` for local runs.

priya: CI requirements? We should block merges if example fixtures don't match new schema.

noah: Yes: CI checks for examples repo will include a schema-validate step against `io.v2.json`. We'll add a GitHub Action that runs the codemod in dry-run for PRs and fails if any remaining v1 fixtures are detected without a rationale comment. Also require docs linter and link-check.

eng-release: Plan: canary tomorrow 09:00 PDT, monitor for 72 hours. If no issues, schedule rolling rollout to docs.prod and examples repo PR merges over two weeks. Shim removal targeted 4 weeks after full rollout.

noah: Please review the preview and the migration guide at the top of the doc. Call out any blockers (customer-facing examples, security, or CI gaps) here before EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
